title: 5 months solo with Claude Code, WW2 RTS where you can also drive the tanks. What the AI did and what it could  not
author: greenlight91
selftext:
Korean here, translator helped with this post.

Almost all code is Claude Code, Unity 6. I design and test, it writes. Armor penetration per plate with no HP  bars, lockstep online, the AI commander, all from that loop. Voice and key art are AI placeholders for now.

  What it could not do: tell me if the game is fun, and keep 5 months of code in its head. It kept re-reading and re-fixing the same things. A hand written one line per file "code map" it reads first fixed most of that.

How do you deal with code you did not write and cannot fully read?
